entries.name: signRank_le_of_computableWithHeadsN
entries.note: Core 028 bridge: clear denominators, expand the product over A/B sides, group by head subset T (P2.3), count the <=2 rank-one pieces per T. Available: denominator_eq_headA_add_headB, exists_numerator_readout_two_block_split, headA_pos/headB_nonneg, denominator_prod_pos, two_mul_two_pow_sub, rank_le_card_of_sum_vecMulVec.

entries.name: signRank_le_sum_choose
entries.note: Take a strict sign rep (exists_strictSignRep_of_ThresholdDegLE), evaluate on the cube via UnivariateReduction.eval_cube_eq_subset_sum, group the support by its left-variable projection into <= card_subsets_card_le outer products, bound the rank with rank_le_card_of_sum_vecMulVec.

entries.name: forster_large_rank
entries.note: Forster large-rank regime: general position (P5.2), isotropic position via Phi-minimization (P5.3 analytic kernel), then the trace/Cauchy-Schwarz chain (P5.4). The small-rank regime forster_small_rank is proved (uses card_le_specNorm_sq).

entries.name: forsterRatio_pow_le_signRank_tensor
entries.note: Remaining hard core is the sign-matrix Kronecker identity signRank (signMatrix (k*m)(k*m) G-tilde) = signRank (kroneckerPow k S1) (P8.2, via tensorEquiv + sign_xor_prod + signRank_reindex/signRank_neg); then kroneckerPow_mem_pm_one + specNorm_kroneckerPow + specNorm_signMatrix_distThreshold + forster + forsterRatio_pow_le_of_forster close it.

entries.name: warren_bound_of_leftShatters
entries.note: Construct the 2H-variable cleared-score polynomials Q_j (totalDegree <= H), strictify all shattered labels by a common eta, and apply warren_sign_patterns; the final ceiling simplification warren_pow_simp is proved.

entries.name: rank_sum_le
entries.note: Finset.induction on s: empty case is Matrix.rank_zero, insertion step is the proved rank_add_le composed with the inductive hypothesis.

entries.name: headA_pos
entries.note: unfold headA; the query term is Head.sigma_pos (> 0) and the finite left sum is Finset.sum_nonneg of Head.sigma_pos.

entries.name: headB_nonneg
entries.note: unfold headB; Finset.sum_nonneg with each term Head.sigma_pos.le.

entries.name: exists_numerator_readout_two_block_split
entries.note: Mirror denominator_eq_headA_add_headB with the readout: real_inner_sum over Head.numerator, then Fintype.sum_option and Fin.sum_univ_add; each some-term depends on one bit (Head_scoreTerm_single, Head_scoreTerm_none_const in ModelToPolynomial). Take A' = query + left sum, B' = right sum.

entries.name: card_subsets_card_le
entries.note: Partition the size-<=d subsets of Fin a by cardinality; (powersetCard i univ).card = C(a,i) by Finset.card_powersetCard + Finset.card_fin; sum over i in range (d+1) via Finset.card_biUnion of the disjoint layers.

entries.name: specNorm_kroneckerPow
entries.note: Induction on k; base is the 1x1 matrix [1] (empty product); step writes kroneckerPow (k+1) M = reindex e e (M kron kroneckerPow k M) for e : (Fin (k+1) -> i) ~ i x (Fin k -> i) (Fin.prod_univ_succ for entries), then specNorm_reindex + specNorm_kronecker.

entries.name: kroneckerPow_mem_pm_one
entries.note: Each entry is a finite product of +/-1; Finset.prod induction (or rcases on each factor) shows a product of +/-1 values is +/-1.

entries.name: forsterRatio_pow_le_of_forster
entries.note: Divide hle by the positive (2C)^k; rewrite 2^(k*m) = (2^m)^k and forsterRatio m = 2^m/(2C) (needs m >= 1, so 2^(m-1)*2 = 2^m and 2^(k*m)/2^k = 2^(k*(m-1))).
